newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU industry output up 1.1 pct in Feb-April.
newsitem.headline: EU industry output up 1.1 pct in Feb-April.

text.p: European Union industrial production rose 1.1 percent between February and April compared with the previous three months, slower growth than in the United States but faster than in Japan, Eurostat said on Friday.
"All member states with available data recorded a rise, the largest being Spain's 2.5 percent and Sweden's 2.0 percent," Eurostat, the EU's statistical office, said in a statement.
Finland and Italy also experienced growth rates above the EU average, up by 1.5 and 1.3 percent respectively.
Britain had the lowest growth in industrial production with a rise of only 0.3 percent.
Compared with the same period last year, EU industry production rose by 2.7 percent, well below the level of 4.5 and 5.9 percent respectively in the United States and Japan.
Eurostat's figures cover industry production volume, excluding construction, and are adjusted for seasonal and one-off fluctuations.
